summary: Iteration 13 full-stack test. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13.py with 38 pytest cases — ALL 38 PASS. Covered the Goals partial-PATCH priority fix (persistence, all 3 values, order-stability, 400 on empty body, 404, 401), Goals CRUD + reorder + foreign-id authz + no _id leak, the two NEW endpoints (POST /api/whatif/subscription and POST /api/whatif/twin) for auth-gating, response shape, math correctness (SIP FV + lump-sum compounding verified against closed-form), validation 422s and no-mutation of goals/transactions, plus regressions (auth/me picture, auth/config, google/start 302, demo overview, settings preferences/export, learn, purchase scenario returning 4 AI options with ai_available=true). Frontend: the reported /goals bug is FIXED end-to-end — priority chips are visible on every card, clicking persists via PATCH and the highlight survives a full reload; the 4-button action bar works, Up/Down are correctly disabled at boundaries, reorder persists across reload, Edit opens a pre-filled modal, Delete opens the styled confirm-delete-modal (native window.confirm NOT used). /twin auto-runs on mount, shows 5y ₹44.51 L / 10y ₹1.07 Cr, renders the Recharts line chart with 3 (then 4) lines, boost_25 + extra_income scenario cards, and lump_sum appears when supplied; overriding monthly savings/return changes the projection. /whatif has both tabs working; Subscription tab renders both comparison cards + verdict card with recommendation; purchase tab still returns 4 Claude options and the previously-broken 'Pinned to AI memory' badge now renders correctly. Zero console errors on all three pages. No blocking defects found; remaining items are spec/polish level.

minor.issue: SPEC DEVIATION: returns only 2 scenarios by default (boost_25, extra_income); the review request states 3 items when no lump_sum is given. With lump_sum it returns 3. Either add a third default scenario or correct the spec.

baseline.series / scenario.series only emit months 12,24,36,48,60,84,120 — years 6, 8 and 9 are missing. Because the frontend XAxis is categorical (dataKey='year'), Yr5→Yr7 and Yr7→Yr10 are rendered with the same pixel width as Yr1→Yr2, visually distorting the growth curve. Emit every 12 months (1..10).

features.py project(): final_5y is read positionally as series[4] and final_10y as series[-1]. This silently returns the wrong year if the sampling list ever changes, and final_5y becomes null for months<60. Select by month == 60 / month == 120 explicitly.

Server-generated strings use western digit grouping (e.g. 'costs ₹110,950', 'label: ₹100,000 lump sum in year 1') via Python format(:,), while the entire UI uses en-IN grouping (₹1,10,950). Numbers formatted by the backend look wrong next to numbers formatted by the frontend.

annual return is hardcoded to 8.0 with no override param (unlike /twin which accepts annual_return), and the endpoint ignores the user's profile entirely, so 'opportunity cost' is not personalised even though the endpoint requires auth.

Naming mismatch: the API returns onetime.future_value_5y/10y but the UI labels those same numbers 'OPPORTUNITY COST 5 YRS', while the subscription card labels subscription.opportunity_cost_* as 'IF INVESTED'. Same concept, two different labels in one screen.

issues: For a guest the page renders only the empty 'Fine-tune your twin' form: run() is skipped when isDemo, so there is no chart, no projection, no explanatory copy and no sign-up CTA — it looks broken. The 'Sign up to project your own net worth' message only appears after the user clicks Update projection. Show a demo projection or an upfront CTA.
X axis ticks are Yr 1,2,3,4,5,7,10 (categorical, uneven spacing) — see backend series issue; the curve shape misrepresents time.
The 'Claude Sonnet 5' AI badge stays in the page header on the Subscription tab even though this tab is pure deterministic math with no LLM call — misleading.
The Verdict card has a large empty area below 'Break-even' (~40% blank) while the left form card is compact; the two-column grid looks unbalanced.
Label inconsistency between the two comparison cards ('IF INVESTED (5 YRS)' vs 'OPPORTUNITY COST 5 YRS' for the same concept).
STILL OPEN from iteration 12: 'Purchase date (optional)' uses the browser-native date input showing mm/dd/yyyy instead of the app's calendar component — US date order in an INR/India-focused app.
STILL OPEN from iteration 12: the primary 'Delete goal' action (danger-btn) is light red text on light pink; contrast is clearly below the neutral Cancel button next to it and hard to read.

The 'LOW PRIORITY / MEDIUM PRIORITY' pill in the card's top-right is very light grey/amber on white and is much lower contrast than the new priority chips directly below it; the two now duplicate the same information.

action_items: SPEC: Decide on the twin default scenario count — implementation returns 2 without lump_sum, the spec says 3. Add a third default scenario or update the spec/frontend copy.
MEDIUM: Emit the twin projection series at every 12 months (years 1-10) so the Recharts x-axis is evenly spaced; today years 6, 8, 9 are missing and the curve is distorted.
MEDIUM: Handle the guest state on /demo/twin — currently a blank form with no chart, no copy and no sign-up CTA.
LOW: Format backend-generated currency strings with Indian digit grouping (lakh/crore) to match the UI (₹1,10,950 not ₹110,950).
LOW: Select twin final_5y/final_10y by month (60/120) instead of series index [4]/[-1].
LOW: Hide the 'Claude Sonnet 5' badge on the Subscription tab (no LLM involved) and unify the 'if invested' / 'opportunity cost' labels across the two comparison cards.
LOW (carried over, still unfixed): raise contrast on the danger 'Delete goal' button; replace the native date input on the What-If purchase form with the app calendar component.
LOW: Consider allowing annual_return on /whatif/subscription (or drop the auth requirement, since the endpoint reads nothing from the user).
critical_code_review_comments: features.py digital_twin(): project() is called 3-4 times, each looping 120 months and re-scanning `if m in (12,24,...)`. Fine at this scale but the sampling tuple and the positional series[4] lookup are coupled — extract the sample months to a module constant and index by month.

features.py: SubscriptionInput / TwinInput / ScenarioInput are declared AFTER build_whatif_router() in the file (lines 440-450 vs usage at 326/369). It works only because the annotations are resolved at call time inside the closure; moving anything will break it. Move all Pydantic models above the router factory.
features.py is at 685 lines and holds learn + whatif + scenario + twin + LLM plumbing; split the What-If/Twin engine into its own module before it crosses the 700-line guideline.
App.js is 1403 lines — Goals (with the new priority row + action bar), Settings and Dashboard should be extracted into src/pages/ files.

DigitalTwin.jsx line 40: useEffect(() => { if (!isDemo) run(); }, []) with an eslint-disable — run() closes over monthlySavings/annualReturn/lumpSum. It works today only because the effect runs once with initial state; if the parent ever remounts with saved inputs the auto-run will use stale values.

DigitalTwin.jsx: no empty/zero-savings guidance — with monthly_savings=0 the boost_25 scenario is numerically identical to baseline and renders a '+0%' card that tells the user nothing (verified via backend test_zero_savings_edge).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional; 6 design/polish issues open

No other data mutated.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for this iteration is /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13.py (38 cases, all green, run with the pre-configured pytest.ini -n 2 --dist loadscope). Note: no-mutation assertions must compare a single fixture-created goal, NOT the whole goals array — xdist loadscope runs classes in parallel on a shared backend and other classes create/delete goals concurrently. /api/whatif/scenario expects field `amount`, not `price`. Iteration-12 bugs confirmed FIXED: pin-to-memory badge (whatif-pinned-<id>) now renders, PATCH /api/goals/{id} is now a true partial update via GoalPatchInput, guest What-If now shows a friendly message instead of raw 'Not authenticated'. Still unfixed from iteration 12: native date picker on What-If, low-contrast danger 'Delete goal' button.
rca_of_the_issue: Original /goals discoverability bug is resolved: App.js now renders a persistent .goal-priority-row (3 chips with data-testid priority-{level}-{goalId}) and a .goal-action-bar (Up/Down/Edit/Delete) on every non-demo card, and server.py switched PATCH /api/goals/{id} from the all-required GoalInput to GoalPatchInput with exclude_none, which is what makes the priority-only PATCH from changePriority() succeed. Verified in the browser: chip click -> PATCH 200 -> reload -> highlight still on the new chip; _load_ordered_goals sorts by `order` first so a priority change does not reshuffle cards (covered by test_priority_change_does_not_move_card).
